TOOLING BURST T4s — T4s — G2 thrown arc → ground field (Blackwater Cocktail, Poisonous Concoction) (Run C-5, E3; architecture 03- § 2.2 grammars, § 2.3 alphabet; specs are conductor-authored with VERIFY flags — implement the spec as written and report any field that the primitives or the runtime cannot honour). task_id "T4s".

Read ONLY, in this order:
1. /Users/admin/Games/reincarnated-collaboration/astra_test_01/burst/SPEC.md — § 0, § 1, § 7 rows T4a, T4b, T4f, T4h (all clauses), T4p, T4q, T4r and the new row "T4s — G2 thrown arc → ground field (Blackwater Cocktail, Poisonous Concoction)" (your contract).
2. /Users/admin/Games/reincarnated-collaboration/astra_test_01/burst/BURST_RULES.md (the TOOLING row).
3. runs/C-5/specs/blackwater_cocktail.json + runs/C-5/specs/poisonous_concoction.json (the specs — LAW: the renderer never selects targets or infers grammar from a name), export/effect_kit.py, export/godot_import.py (G1 component, pieces phase, screen_px, key states, T4r's burst_v1r + decal), export/vfx_material.gdshader, oracle/peak_pieces.py (run only), the primitives (512 working copies, four-plane greyscale RGBA unless noted): VF-prim-flask-01/flask_01_512.png (RGB MATERIAL — keep colour; no value-index), VF-prim-poison-lobe-01/poison_lobe_01_512.png, VF-prim-poison-puff-01/poison_puff_01_512.png, E0p-peak-01/fire_peak_01_512.png + fire_burst_e0p_v2 (the fire splash), and for the fire pool a P03 field body derived at emission from the fire peak's core piece (no new painting), runs/C-5/vfx_kits/v9/fire_bolt_e1_B/kit.json and ice_bolt_e2/kit.json (templates), tests/test_effect_kit.py, tests/test_godot_import.py, tests/test_vfx_picker.py (extend only).
Do not read anything else. No web. No agents. No image generation. No pip install. stdlib + Pillow + numpy + scipy ONLY; Godot for headless import/trace only (rendered = conductor's).

BUILD the G2 grammar as a second runtime component `scenes/vfx/g2_thrown_field.tscn` + script, emitted like T4b's G1: (1) THROW — ground-locked aim (cast target = a ground point at range along facing on touch devices; mouse point on desktop, clamped to range), a ballistic arc (apex_px, flight_s from the spec) for the RGB FLASK sprite (material layer: MIX, scene-lit, rotation locked to ±15° tumble, NOT on the T4a index material — the material-glass gate: the dark glass with its pale reflection must stay opaque), landing at the ground point with a 1-frame contact; (2) SHATTER — 3 glass fragments (cut from the flask sprite by simple wedges at emission) fly low and short (0.2 s) on the MIX material, plus the treatment's splash: fire = fire_burst_e0p_v2 at 0.7 scale; poison = 4 poison lobes translating low and short (burst_v1 motion, 0.25 s, no residue); (3) FIELD — ground-bound (0.58 squash, ground layer under actors, sorted by the ground point): fire = a P03 field body (the fire peak's core piece, squashed) pulsing 3 P01-style licks (the fire head primitive) on the tick schedule, each lick a 6-frame rise-and-erode at a random angle; poison = the lobed density puff as a DENSITY layer — coverage grows from 0.5 to 1.0 over 0.4 s then holds, with a slow drift (2 px/s) and a 3-frame breathe of alpha 0.85–1.0 on the tick schedule — the density is a separate kit field `density` (0–1) that scales the puff's alpha, never an asserted key; duration_s from the spec; ticks at the spec's irregular schedule (assert interval CV ≥ 0.25 — FF-08); victim tint on every actor inside radius_px at each tick; (4) RESIDUE — scorch / puddle decal on the ground layer for residue_s, MIX; (5) kits `blackwater_cocktail_e3` and `poisonous_concoction_e3` registered (screen_px), replacing nothing (the six legacy kits stay).
ACCEPTANCE (runs/C-5/t3/T4s/acceptance.json): headless trace of one throw east at 480 px: flask apex within ±10 px of the spec, landing at the ground point, shatter fragments ≤ 0.2 s, field alive for duration_s with the tick count and interval CV reported (≥ 0.25), victim tint events on the dummy inside the field, decal appears at landing and fades by residue_s; both kits validate; previously registered kits byte-identical; in-sandbox suite reds named.
Tests (unittest, stdlib): kit validation; the emitted scenes contain the named nodes; headless clock traces per the ACCEPTANCE; all previously registered kits export byte-identically; headless import exit 0.
DO NOT touch: lane/, bible/, fixtures/, briefs/, SPEC.md, BURST_RULES.md, REGISTER_CARD.md, JUDGE_RUBRIC.md, MANIFEST.sha256, receipt.schema.json, transcribe.schema.json, oracle/ (run only), export/replay.py, any test file except the three named (extend only), anything under runs/ except runs/C-5/t3/T4s/, the new kit directories named above and their registration lines in kits_v9.json. Do not run git. Temporary files ONLY under runs/C-5/t3/T4s/. Write out/files.json listing every file you changed with sha256.
RETURN: the receipt (task_id "T4s"): files = every changed path with sha256; images = 0 (INTEGER); calls_used; status DELIVERED / DELIVERED_WITH_CONCERNS / FAILED with concerns listed honestly.
